title: poker dungeon
description:
《Poker Dungeon》is a unique character development card game that blends elements of Rougelike with poker gameplay, drawing inspiration from Chinese card games like Landlord (with pairs, bombs, etc.). In this game, you'll encounter a variety of interesting characters and monsters.

Players take on the role of adventurers, embarking on adventures in a challenging world of poker cards. By collecting and nurturing different game characters, you'll build powerful decks and engage in intense battles with monsters. Each game character has unique skills and abilities, and you'll need to cleverly utilize them according to the situation, devising the best card-playing strategies

 

Game features
Multiple characters + cards

 

No In-app purchase  Character summon

Roguelike game
